title: Muckleroy's Guide Service

services.name: Fishing Trips
services.desc: Captain Dean Muckleroy specializes in action packed speckled trout, redfish and flounder adventures aboard his 24 ft. Triton boat! Captain Dean Muckleroy has 35 years of experience as a fishing guide in the Galveston Bay area. If you're looking for a private Galveston Bay fishing guide who specializes in catching speckled trout, redfish, and flounder, you've come to the right place. Dean offers private fishing adventures to anglers looking for a good time on the water anywhere in the Galveston Bay Complex. He also runs seasonal fishing trips that target other species of fish. All anglers are welcome, from the seasoned angler to the family with small children looking for their first fishing
